results.overview: Join a group of six fourth-grade best friends at Third Street Elementary School on their fun-filled adventures in their school playground. Through the ups-and-downs of adolescence, they must wrestle with authority, avoid the school snitch, and try their best to win at kick-ball.
results.name: Recess

results.overview: A young teacher goes to a school for adults. He is younger than many of his students and some of them are starting to miss school.
results.name: The Long Recess
